target: forge.sh push — the injected header is appended to a caller's GIT_CONFIG_* environment instead of replacing it
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.example GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=1
fx_run push feat; fx_show r
L="$(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null)"
echo "count=$(printf '%s' "$L" | grep -o 'GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=[0-9]*')"
if printf '%s' "$L" | grep -o 'keys=[^ ]*' | grep -qF 'core.example'; then echo keeps-caller-key=yes; else echo keeps-caller-key=no; fi
if printf '%s' "$L" | grep -o 'keys=[^ ]*' | grep -qF 'http.https://gitlab.example.test/.extraheader'; then echo has-inject-key=yes; else echo has-inject-key=no; fi
echo "pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
fx_done
